utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming — I’ll see you at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Perfect, thanks — just wanted to make sure.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. If you can bring any tools and spare screws you have, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—I’ll grab my tools and any spare screws I can find. What should I tackle first for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Let’s start with the loose hinges and that broken shelf, if you can.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Ira — I’m still sorting the list, mostly tools and a few hands. If you can help, please let me know what you can bring.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can bring a few basic tools and help however needed at the repair drive. Send me the list when it’s ready and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps a lot, thanks. I’ll send you the list once I’ve got the basics sorted.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure thing — I’m happy to help connect everyone for the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Jules. Do you know the exact room for the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m not sure of the exact room yet, but I can find out and pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure thing — what part of the repair drive do you want me to help with?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just send me the missing items, and I’ll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll send over the missing items right now, and thanks for helping out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I’m still coming to the repair drive this weekend. What time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Hana — could you be there around 10 AM? I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: 10 AM works for me — I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes please, that’d be great—thanks, Opal. Let me know the exact room when you find it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’m heading there now, and I’ll update you as soon as I confirm the exact room for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — I appreciate it. I’ll wait for your update so I can share the exact room with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s happening for real—go ahead and tell people the repair drive is on!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Tess, sorry I’m late—what’s still left to do? I can help with the fence if you still need hands.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Dane — the fence still needs help, and sorting the broken stuff is still on the list too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up on the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can still lend a hand and a few tools if you need them. What’s the next thing on the list?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus—I'm still trying to get the full list. Eli said we need a clear rundown of what's broken and who's taking each job before it really gets moving.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m still a bit out of the loop, so I should check what’s new and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No problem — I’ll send over the latest list shortly, and we can go from there. Thanks again for helping with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Eli — send it over when you can, and I’ll take a look and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate it. Just let me know if there’s anything else I can do for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive, and I’ll make sure you get pointed to the fence fix too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thanks — I can help with the fence fix.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo. Just let me know what’s still missing, and I’ll help if I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m just about done checking—once I’ve got the last missing items, I’ll bring you the list for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo. I’ll be here when you’ve got it together.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll send the list over soon, and I’ll make sure the fence fix stays first so we keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Eli—once you send it, I’ll start spreading the word and line up folks for the repairs.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll get that list to you soon, starting with the fence fix so we can keep everything orderly.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No problem, Noah — just let me know what’s left when you check, and I can jump in on the fence or whatever else needs hands.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Dane. I’ll check what’s new on the repair drive and let you know what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, Noah — I’ll be ready to help once you know what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m in for the repair drive. I’ll send over the broken items and names as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming. Just send the broken items and names when you can, and I’ll keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Will do — I’ll send the broken items and names as soon as I’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and a few tools if you need them for the repair drive. What’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Gus — I’m still sorting through what we need, but extra tools and any spare screws would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got some spare tools and screws you can use—just let me know what else you end up needing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks—just send me the exact room when you confirm it, and I’ll help spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m on it—I’ll confirm the exact room for the repair drive and send it over as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks Opal — I’ll keep sharing the word and wait for the exact room.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — we’re still sorting donations and matching them to the biggest repair needs, and we could really use help with pickup and a quick inventory check. I’m happy to catch you up on the details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Sam — I can help with the pickup and inventory check if you point me to what’s needed first.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll send you the pickup list first, then we can do the inventory check together. Thanks, Nell, that’ll really help us keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m still trying to keep it aligned with the school schedule—do we have a time set for the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — it’s set for Sunday at the community center. I’m still confirming the exact time, and I’ll let everyone know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday works much better for me if we can keep it after school stuff. Please let me know the exact time as soon as you have it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Just checking in—did you find the exact room for the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Not yet, I’m still waiting on the room number. Thanks—I’ll get there a bit early and be ready once you send it over.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—please send the room number as soon as you have it. I’ll keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, see you there — I’ll help out where I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — appreciate it. I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive, and see you there.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, Vik — thanks for spreading the word. See you at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I’ll keep an eye out for any urgent repairs and let you know. If you need anything else for the drive, just send me the list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Bo — I’ll send you the list if anything comes up. Also, just to confirm, what time should I be there for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m not sure on the exact time yet — I’ll check and let you know as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, I’ll spread the word, but we should keep it to small batches so the logistics don’t get messy.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That makes sense — small batches will keep things manageable, and I’ll keep folks posted if anything changes for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps. I’ll stick to small batches and keep an eye on the timing so Sunday stays manageable.
